{{Nav Games Header}}
<b>Fast Travel</b> refers to methods of instantly travelling directly from one [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] to another. Throughout the game, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] encounters three main methods of fast travel: Bellways, Ventrica, and the Beastling Call.

== Bellways ==
The Bellways are an interconnected system of tunnels throughout [[Pharloom]] that link different areas together via stations. Hornet can traverse the Bellways with the help of the [[Bell Beast]] after freeing and defeating her in [[the Marrow]].

Most stations require activating a toll machine with [[Rosaries]].

A set of Bellway Pins may be purchased from [[Shakra]] for {{R|60}}, which mark the location of every discovered Bellway station on any maps.

== Ventrica ==
The Ventrica are a system of tubes that run throughout [[the Citadel]] and the [[Underworks]], which Hornet can use to travel, similar to the Bellways. The [[Grand Bellway]] station connects the two systems of travel.

Most stations require activating a toll machine with [[Rosaries]].

After unlocking the first Ventrica Station and speaking to [[Shakra]], a set of Ventrica Pins may be purchased for {{R|80}}, which marks the location of every discovered Ventrica Station on any maps.

== Beastling Call ==
{{Main|Beastling Call}}
The Beastling Call is a [[Needolin]] [[Abilities (Silksong)|ability]] gained from the Bell Beast after defeating [[Bell Eater]]. It allows Hornet to quickly warp to her most recently used Bellway station.

==Trivia==
* While [[Mount Fay]] lacks a Bellway, the western building with the [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] is internally referred to as one.
* There are many [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Graphics|unused graphics]] still in the game related to both Bellways and Ventrica, including unused map segments.
* If the First Shrine Ventrica is not locked at the start of Act 3, it becomes blocked off, but can be opened again from the inside by destroying the rubble. However, the Terminus Ventrica is permanently disconnected from the rest of [[the Cradle]].
